limitations: Actual native CLI terminals and published MCP packages were driven by operator-queued deterministic local model responses. This is not hosted-model reasoning, GUI or usability evidence.
Fresh unfunded wallets signed offline only. RPC/REST used disabled loopback endpoints; no chain or provider resources were created.
Minimal offline config omits converterAddress and faucetUrl; CosmWasm is unavailable and the faucet tool absent. Actual chain list_modules passed.
Saved schema 2/3 manifests, draft and journal are synthetic fixtures. Live deployment records are separate evidence.
Legacy upgrade uses tagged 0.4.0 and native remove/install under the same identity; marketplace update-in-place and other historical versions are untested.
Private-file credential migration does not establish native OS-store access, cross-machine portability or other operating systems.
This replay used a warmed private npm cache and connected without a native chain reconnect. It does not invalidate the earlier cold-start timeout reported in the initial 0.5.0 run.

harness.hashScope: These hashes identify on-disk preservation and driver helper bytes at report assembly, for reproduction reference. The driver was revised during the multi-phase run, and each daemon's loaded revision was not independently hashed at launch. These hashes therefore do not establish that every earlier daemon phase loaded these exact helper bytes. The separate sourceHashes inventory binds the 70 frozen plugin source files; preservation measurements and installed-package comparisons are unchanged.
